articles.title: Bats May Have First Appeared in Europe, Study Says
articles.summary: A huge study of bat genomes and fossils suggests bats first evolved in Europe about 65 million years ago, and that flight and echolocation appeared early.

articles.title: New 'Plant Armor' Cover More Than Triples Strawberry Yields
articles.summary: A three-dimensional fabric placed over strawberry plants blocked insects and raised yields by up to 3.56 times in tunnel trials, without harming plant health.

articles.title: Big Female Pythons Cause the Most Trouble in Florida
articles.summary: A new scoring system suggests hunters should target large adult female Burmese pythons, and that winter hunts may be more effective than summer ones.
